INSERT INTO intel.insider_tx (id, ticker, filed_at, tx_date, insider, tx_type, code, shares, price, value, derivative, source, updated_at)
SELECT id, ticker, filed_at, tx_date, insider, tx_type, code, shares, price, value, derivative, 'finnhub', now()
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(id text, ticker text, filed_at date, tx_date date, insider text, tx_type text, code text, shares bigint, price numeric, value numeric, derivative boolean)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET filed_at = EXCLUDED.filed_at, tx_date = EXCLUDED.tx_date, insider = EXCLUDED.insider, tx_type = EXCLUDED.tx_type, code = EXCLUDED.code, shares = EXCLUDED.shares, price = EXCLUDED.price, value = EXCLUDED.value, derivative = EXCLUDED.derivative, source = EXCLUDED.source, updated_at = now();
INSERT INTO intel.analyst_recs (ticker, as_of, strong_buy, buy, hold, sell, strong_sell, source, updated_at)
SELECT ticker, as_of, strong_buy, buy, hold, sell, strong_sell, 'finnhub', now()
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS r(ticker text, as_of date, strong_buy int, buy int, hold int, sell int, strong_sell int)
ON CONFLICT (ticker, as_of) DO UPDATE SET strong_buy = EXCLUDED.strong_buy, buy = EXCLUDED.buy, hold = EXCLUDED.hold, sell = EXCLUDED.sell, strong_sell = EXCLUDED.strong_sell, source = EXCLUDED.source, updated_at = now();
INSERT INTO intel.api_usage (run_id, source, endpoint, ticker, status, http_code)
SELECT $3::uuid, 'finnhub', endpoint, ticker, status, http_code
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($4::jsonb) AS u(ticker text, endpoint text, status text, http_code int);

return [{ json: { source: 'signals', insider_rows: f.insider_rows, rec_rows: f.rec_rows, calls: f.calls, failed: f.failed, failed_tickers: f.failed_tickers, ok: f.calls > 0 && f.failed < f.calls } }];

parameters.content:
## Input

Called with {run_id, as_of, tickers[], benchmarks[]}.

## Fan out + fetch

One item per non-ETF ticker, then the two calls in series. neverError with the full response: a bad reply becomes a ledger row, not a crash.

## Normalize + store

Rows matched back to tickers by request order, then one transaction: insiders, recs, ledger.

## Return

Row counts and failed tickers go back to Daily for the run status.

## Collect-Signals: source + rules

Two Finnhub calls per non-ETF ticker, 1.1 s apart, about two minutes.
**stock/insider-transactions** (SEC Form 4, 120 days back): one intel.insider_tx row per transaction, keyed by accession + detail so a re-pull updates in place. tx_type keeps P (open-market buy) / S (sale) / other; the SEC code and the derivative flag are stored so the score can ignore option exercises, awards, gifts and tax withholding.
**stock/recommendation**: monthly buy / hold / sell counts, one intel.analyst_recs row per (ticker, month), upserted.
A ticker whose call fails keeps its old rows. Every call lands in intel.api_usage.
